Users of, or people considering using Ghostery should be aware of a few things regarding this extension:

  • It's proprietary. That means you have no guarentee that it doesn't do anything beyond what it says it does, other than the companys (Ghostery Inc.) word. source

  • Ghostry Inc. is an advertising company (current owners and distributers of Ghostery). source

  • It comes with an opt-in feature that, when enabled, sends information about the ads that it blocks to the advertises. source

In my opinion, if you're concerned about being tracked and your online privacy, then the first two points should be enough to discourage use of Ghostery.
